title: CSOS certificate is personal to the subscriber
rule_summary: A DEA CSOS certificate is issued to an individual subscriber and may be used to digitally sign controlled-substance orders only by that individual; another employee may not borrow or share the subscriber's certificate.
exam_relevance: Tests whether electronic ordering authority follows the named individual subscriber rather than the pharmacy workstation or job title.

authority.name: DEA CSOS Q&A
authority.section: About and usage of CSOS certificates

exceptions: A separate properly authorized subscriber or person with valid power of attorney may use that person's own DEA-issued certificate.
common_confusions: Assuming a certificate installed on a shared pharmacy computer can be used by any pharmacist or manager.
verification_notes: Current official primary or official agency source checked on 2026-08-14.
